events.happens: Rationing becomes public; bread hits scarcity price cap; NPCs skip meals (hunger rises, health falls slowly); food-theft chance rises; happiness -10/month while active.
events.name: Food shortage
events.reason: The granary starts half-full; one bad winter away. The stakes WORLD.md ordered.

events.happens: Wolves take 1-3 livestock at loc_farm; npc_ralf_hale and the night watch respond; 50-copper bounty per pelt claimable; safety -15 for the month; tavern talk for days.
events.name: Wolf attack
events.reason: 2-4 incidents per winter is the budgeted danger; the event is the budget made mechanical.

events.happens: Work pauses; gathering at loc_square; happiness +15 for the month; tavern revenue doubles that week. Harvest Feast: debts under 20 copper forgiven. Longnight: bonfire consumes extra item_firewood.
events.name: Festival
events.reason: Festivals are the village heartbeat; calendar dates are facts, not story beats.

events.happens: A building catches fire (small daily seeded chance: forge left hot, hearth accident). Each household water barrel gives a containment roll; usually limited to one building. Infrastructure -10 per building damaged; community fund pays repairs; happiness -5.
events.name: Fire
events.reason: Fire kills more villagers than monsters; the water-barrel law must matter mechanically.

events.happens: npc_bram_stone doubles patrols (schedule shifts); households lock doors earlier (evening schedules shift); shop wariness rises (prices +1, stranger suspicion); travelers warned at loc_tavern. A player flaunting wealth can be the trigger. If evidence surfaces, npc_bram_stone acts under village law (restitution, public apology, stocks, or banishment).
events.name: Theft wave
events.reason: The Apple Test's social aftermath, generalized: the village learns, systemically.

events.happens: Merchants at loc_square for 2-3 days: npc_tilda_bray restocks imports; npc_doran_kettle buys item_iron_stock; villagers sell apples, pelts, honey (~800 copper inflow); import prices dip 10%; news from King's Rest arrives as rumor input.
events.name: Merchant arrival
events.reason: The village lifeline and the money source the economy balances on.

events.happens: Illness spreads by contact (sim's contact rules pick the sick; no targeting). Demand spikes for item_remedy and item_fever_tea; sick NPCs miss work (production dips). In harsh runs the old or weak can die: from the numbers, never scripted.
events.name: Fever
events.reason: The fever winter that widowed Mira, Garrick and Doran is in living memory.

events.happens: Autumn harvest yields x0.6 (item_grain and item_apple); river runs low (ford easy: trade briefly up; fish stock down); fire risk rises. Corvin's east-field clearing argument gains urgency.
events.name: Drought
events.reason: Weather is the slow disaster: it never attacks, it just doesn't rain.

events.happens: loc_mill stops: no item_flour within days, npc_oda_fenn cannot bake, bread hits scarcity cap. Replacement becomes an open community project: 8000 copper + timber from npc_tam_oakes + iron fittings from npc_doran_kettle + labor. Until then, hand querns (slow, poor quality).
events.name: The wheel fails
events.reason: The cracking wheel is the village's most visible shared problem: failure is a when, not an if.

events.happens: Multi-season community project over loc_river_alder ford: ~40 item_log, item_iron_stock fittings, Restday labor (villagers and player can contribute labor, timber, or coin). When done: winter trade no longer drops to zero, trade +10 permanently, infrastructure +10.
events.name: Building the bridge
events.reason: The hope nobody says aloud, turned into conditions and work, never a quest. councilAgrees is read from npc_elswith_alder, npc_garrick_alder and npc_bram_stone goals/relationships each season.

inMigration.effect: At most one new background household (+3-5 people) per season. The 20 simulated NPCs stay fixed in the prototype.
inMigration.reason: A frontier village absorbs newcomers slowly; word travels by merchant and traveler, and there must be a roof.

conditions: per-NPC: age 15-25, ambition >= 70, low prospects or family tension
outMigration.effect: Youth may leave for King's Rest (Piotr's plan, generalized per-NPC). Population -1 each; household happiness dips.
outMigration.reason: The young keep leaving (WORLD.md); decline runs through departures, not death, except harsh winters.

villageToTown.reason: The sim runs months, not the years 4x population growth needs. Thresholds exist so growth has a direction, not a button.

stats.calculation: living simulated NPCs + background villagers (100, abstracted)
stats.name: Population
stats.reason: WORLD.md: ~120 people in 30 households; 20 simulated in full.

stats.calculation: sum of simulated NPC money + village fund + granary stock at base price + shop stocks at base price
stats.name: Wealth
stats.reason: 20 NPCs hold ~9,600 copper (CHARACTERS.md) + fund ~1,000 + granary 50 sacks x 8 = 400; sim computes exactly.

stats.calculation: days of village food in storage (granary + household cellars) / 180 * 100, capped at 100
stats.name: Food supply
stats.reason: Granary ~50 of 100 sacks ~= 23 days for 30 households + ~40 days household stores ~= 63 days -> 35. Deliberately worried entering winter.

stats.calculation: 100 - (wolf incidents this winter * 15) - (unresolved crimes * 5) + (night watch active ? 10 : 0) + palisade bonus 0-10
stats.name: Safety
stats.reason: Wolves bolder the last two winters; palisade sound; one guard. Danger at the edges, not the square.

stats.name: Housing
stats.reason: Everyone housed, no slack: young adults double up. A new household would wait.

stats.calculation: working-age NPCs with productive work / working-age NPCs * 100
stats.name: Employment
stats.reason: Almost everyone works; children and elders excluded from the denominator.

stats.calculation: this month's traveler + merchant copper / 1700 (peak warm month) * 100
stats.name: Trade
stats.reason: Early autumn: ~900 traveler copper + a merchant visit ~= 1275/1700. Follows ECONOMY.md's seasonal curve.

stats.calculation: average over simulated NPCs of (social need met * 0.4 + food security * 0.3 + recent festival * 0.2 - fear events * 0.1)
stats.name: Happiness
stats.reason: Cozy baseline; Harvest Feast approaching; the granary worry drags below 75.

stats.calculation: theft + burglary + vandalism events logged in the last 30 days
stats.name: Crime
stats.reason: Low baseline (Tom's windfalls) so a real theft wave is noticeable. A count, not a scale: 2 vs 8 is legible.

stats.calculation: wheel condition * 0.4 + palisade * 0.25 + well and roads * 0.2 + granary building * 0.15
stats.name: Infrastructure
stats.reason: Wheel 30 -> 12; palisade 80 -> 20; well/roads 70 -> 14; granary 75 -> 11. The wheel is the big drag.

stats.calculation: (apple fame 70 + road safety 60 + hospitality 65) / 3, moved by traveler experiences
stats.name: Outward reputation
stats.reason: How outsiders see Millbrook; distinct from D-09's player-reputation-by-group.
